suggestion.reason: f5 supports rollback and native forks for Claude and OpenCode, so the agent can get history the fork doesn't show. The fix has to be reimplemented inside f5's fork path.

topics.summary: Turns from rolled-back runs no longer bound a native fork. Claude forks at the pinned head when no terminal turn follows the boundary. A fork from before an undo no longer gives the agent work the user undid.
topics.title: Native forks after an undo no longer copy later turns

suggestion.reason: This is a reliability fix for idle compaction, if f5 has that feature. It does not touch the declined compact-before-send behavior.

topics.summary: When idle compaction picks the latest run, it ignores cancelled runs that never started. Removing a queued follow-up or turning it into a steer no longer silently skips the pre-expiry /compact.
topics.title: Idle compaction still runs after a queued message is removed or steered

suggestion.reason: Fixes incomplete context when switching providers or opening a side chat. Reimplement in f5's handoff layer.

topics.summary: Provider-switch history and side-chat or fork delta summaries list every path of a multi-file change, not just the first. The receiving agent learns about every edited file.
topics.title: Handoff context names every file of a multi-file patch

suggestion.reason: Fixes a git and worktree bug in monorepo subfolder projects. The files exist in f5.

topics.summary: The branch picker recognizes the checkout that contains a subfolder project as the project's own. Picking its branch no longer moves the thread into worktree mode at the repo root or stops the session.
topics.title: Picking a branch in a subfolder project keeps the thread in the project folder

suggestion.reason: This fixes a delegation bug: child questions sat unanswered behind long parent turns.

topics.summary: A child's question notice now steers into the parent's running turn, as background task completions do, when the provider can steer without interrupting. Before, notices queued behind long orchestrator turns and were never seen.
topics.title: Subagent questions reach a busy parent agent

topics.reason: F5 uses externally installed Codex executables and has no managed Codex runtime pin or startup installer to upgrade.

suggestion.reason: On the old runtime, Codex compacts after every tool call with GPT-6.1 Sol. This is high impact if f5 uses the managed Codex runtime.

topics.summary: Bumps the pinned managed Codex to 0.166.0, whose catalog keeps GPT-6.1 Sol tools behind code mode. Existing managed installs below the pin are upgraded at startup.
topics.title: Managed Codex runtime moves to 0.166.0 so GPT-6.1 Sol stops compacting

suggestion.reason: Fixes a Pi login loss whose symptom can occur in f5's Pi provider.

topics.summary: Pi RPC processes that T3 stops right after they answer (status, discovery, text generation, forks) launch with --offline. Pi's startup catalog refresh can no longer spend a single-use refresh token and then get killed, which broke ChatGPT sign-in with invalid_grant.
topics.title: Short-lived Pi processes run --offline so rotated OAuth tokens aren't lost

topics.summary: The synchronous login-shell environment probe uses SIGKILL when its 5 s timeout expires. Startup scripts that trap SIGTERM can no longer block server startup.
topics.title: Timed-out login shell probes are force-killed
